driver.name: Driver model
driver.about: The driver's own share of race and qualifying pace once the car is taken out, and points against the forecast.

pace.name: Pace model
pace.about: Fuel- and tyre-corrected lap pace against the field, for drivers and for cars.

elo.name: Elo ratings
elo.about: Our driver Elo against the whole field and against the team-mate.

forecast.name: Race forecast
forecast.about: Our pre-race forecast of every finishing position, and the points it expects.

driver_effect: The driver's own share of race pace once the car is taken out: how much faster or slower than the team-mate, per lap. Negative is faster.
quali_driver_effect: The same split for one-lap pace: the driver's qualifying speed with the car removed. Negative is faster.
race_h2h: Share of races finished ahead of the team-mate, the one rival in identical machinery.
team_points_share: The driver's share of everything the team scored: how much of the car's haul became points.
race_pace: Fuel- and tyre-corrected lap time against the field average. Car and driver together. Negative is faster.
points_per_race: Championship points per start, sprints included. The bottom line, car and driver together.
elo_teammate: A career rating built only from head-to-heads with team-mates, so a fast car cannot lift it.
lap1_gain: Places gained from the grid to the end of lap one: starts and first-lap racecraft.
quali_h2h: Share of qualifying sessions ahead of the team-mate.
quali_gap_tm_pct: Median gap to the team-mate's best lap in the same segment, % of the lap. Negative is faster.
race_pace_tm_delta: Corrected race pace minus the team-mate's in the same race.
race_pace_h2h: Share of races where the driver's corrected pace beat the team-mate's.
quali_pace: Corrected one-lap pace against the field mean. Negative is faster.
avg_finish: Mean finishing position over classified finishes.
q3_rate: Share of qualifying sessions reaching Q3 (2006 on).
elo: Rating of finishing order against the whole field, car included.
pos_gained: Grid slot minus finishing position over classified finishes.
dnf_rate: Share of starts that ended unclassified.
dnf_driver: Retirements recorded as accident, collision or spin.
consistency: Spread of clean corrected laps. Lower is steadier.
avg_fastest_rank: Mean rank of the driver's fastest lap in each race (2004 on).
sector_rank: Mean rank of the driver's best sector times (OpenF1, 2023 on).
corner_speed_delta: Median slowest speed through corners against the field (telemetry, 2023 on); mostly the car.
overtakes_made: On-track passes made per race (OpenF1, 2023 on).
net_overtakes: Passes made minus passes suffered, per race (2023 on).
tyre_mgmt: Degradation against the field on the same compound.
points_v_expected: Points minus the forecast's expected points at lights-out (2025 on).

car_race_pace: The car's share of race pace with the drivers taken out, against the field average. Negative is faster.
points_per_race: Constructors' points per round, both cars and sprints included.
dnf_rate: Share of the team's starts that ended unclassified: reliability and incidents.
pit_lane_v_field: Median time through the pit lane against the race's median, so the circuit's lane length cancels (2011 on).
pit_under_2500: Share of stationary times under 2.5 seconds (OpenF1, 2023 on).
strategy_gain: Places gained or lost around pit stops against the race's norm, per car-race (2011 on).
car_quali_pace: The car's share of one-lap pace. Negative is faster.
car_pace_latest: The car's race-pace state at the latest round.
car_pace_trend: Car pace over the last third of rounds minus the first third. Negative is improvement.
avg_best_finish: Mean finish of the better-placed car.
avg_best_grid: Mean grid slot of the better-placed car.
both_points_rate: Share of rounds in which both cars scored.
pit_best_ms: Fastest stationary time of the season.
corner_speed: Drivers' mean minimum corner speed against the field (2023 on).
top_speed: Mean speed-trap reading (2023 on). Unstable season to season.
tyre_mgmt: Mean of the drivers' degradation against the field.
lead_driver_share: How the points split between the cars (0.5 = even).
car_share: Share of model-expected points the car explains (Shapley split).

min.unit: share of completed rounds entered (len(log) / rounds done)
